docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Paul Elmer More’s verse renderings of a hundred epigrams, chiefly from the Śatakas of Bhartṛhari, on love, wisdom and renunciation (Boston, 1899). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A century of Indian epigrams, chiefly from the Sanskrit of Bhartrihari · Bhartrhari · 1899, 136 scanned pages. Published 1899; Paul Elmer More died 1937; the poems are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
